acceptanceCriteria: The original P2 proof head, acceptance packet blob and SHA-256, Message Policy Program digest, and all other P2 canonical digests remain immutable inputs rather than being relabelled or regenerated.
Policy-protected Query execution receives only DataCursorV2 with one sibling Policy scope digest over sparse compiler-used execution facts; DataCursorV1 is never reinterpreted.
Cursor shape, canonical bytes, domain, encoding, size bound, validation precedence, diagnostics, nondisclosure, and recovery are exact and add no Policy-free execution surface.
QP-POLICY-001 missingDefaultPolicy and QP-POLICY-002 ambiguousDefaultPolicy are the only promoted Policy diagnostics and remain fatal compile failures rather than runtime denial results.
BETA-04 is the sole agent-ready issue because exact accepted BETA-01 through BETA-03 merge heads satisfy its dependency chain; readiness is mechanically derived and has non-inert negative controls.

The exact reviewed projection is losslessly base64-wrapped, limited to ADR, internal/public documentation, BETA-04 design context, and P16 queue governance; it changes no production SQL, Runtime implementation, or performance evidence.
PostgreSQL remains the only durable dependency, the public Index remains B-tree-only, and the revision adds no RLS, raw SQL, aggregate, backward-pagination, or provider-matrix authority.
